_comment: Contract v2 shared by the renderer (scenes_lib.js), the verifier, the storyboard director and the web app. v2 adds BEATS (small timed actions so a scene is never static), the Al-Kahf scene pack (cave, dog, sleepers, man, ruler, wall, rock, fish, barrier...) and their events.
rules: Allah is never depicted in any form, not as light, not as a figure, not as a voice-source.
Prophets are drawn ONLY as labelled light drops (type 'prophet'). Angels ONLY as golden light drops (type 'angel'). Never as people.
Maryam and the Mothers of the Believers are drawn ONLY as labelled light drops (type 'honored'), never as women.
The unseen (Paradise, Hell, the Day of Judgement, the Throne, Jinn, the grave, the Hereafter) is never illustrated literally: use the 'ambient' scene for those passages.
Rulings, du'a, Allah's names and attributes, and admonition use the 'ambient' scene.
Where the Quran leaves a number to Allah's knowledge, never show a countable group (use 'sleepers', which is drawn uncountable).
Killing and violence are never shown; use the 'ambient' scene for such verses.
No text is baked into the art; the only scene text is the prophet/angel name label.

beats.description: params.beats = [{at:[verse,word], do, who, to}]: small actions on a word so the picture keeps moving. Aim for one beat every 3-6 s of recitation; at most 24 per chapter; at least 0.8 s apart. The renderer also adds gentle automatic camera moves wherever no beat happens for 5 s.

camera.shot_wide: camera eases back to show the whole stage
camera.shot_close: camera eases in on 'who' (an actor id or an anchor)
camera.shot_sky: camera tilts up toward the sky
camera.shot_ground: camera tilts down toward the ground
camera.pan_left: camera drifts to the left part of the stage
camera.pan_right: camera drifts to the right part of the stage
camera.push_in: slow dramatic push-in on the centre

actor.turn: who turns to face the other way
actor.point: who points toward 'to' (left|center|right or an actor id)
actor.bow: who lowers the head (humility, sorrow, regret)
actor.speak: who speaks: small sound waves near the head (dialogue)
actor.look_up: who looks up to the sky
actor.wring_hands: who turns the hands over in regret

scene.birds: a few birds take off and cross the sky
scene.wind: a gust: grass, robes and dust move
scene.sparkle: a soft sparkle on 'who' (actor id or anchor), or the centre
scene.clouds_part: clouds part and light comes through

ambient.light_up: the light swells for a moment
ambient.wither: plants dry and scatter in the wind
ambient.pattern_turn: a new ring of the pattern lights up (geometric)
ambient.ink_waves: flowing dark lines spread over the sea like ink (sea)

ambient.description: Calm, non-figurative background that breathes with the recitation (soft light pulses on each word). Safe for every passage. Beats allowed: camera beats, 'scene' beats birds/wind/sparkle/clouds_part/leaves, and the 'ambient' beats.

night_sky.label: Night sky & crescent
night_sky.use: reflection, mercy, signs at night, the unseen, the Hereafter (non-literal)

dawn.label: Dawn over the dunes
dawn.use: hope, relief after hardship, guidance, beginnings

sea.label: Calm sea
sea.use: signs in the sea, ships, provision, patience

garden.label: Palms & a river
garden.use: provision, gratitude, blessings of this world (NOT a depiction of Paradise)

rain.label: Rain on the land
rain.use: rain, reviving dead land, mercy, resurrection as a parable

geometric.label: Geometric pattern
geometric.use: Allah's names and attributes, tawhid, the Quran, the unseen, rulings

stage.description: A simple flat-vector story stage: one setting, a few actors, timed events and beats. Use for narrated events in the life of this world (stories of prophets and nations).

garden.label: Gardens & farms (vines, palms, crops, a river between)

cave.label: Inside a cave, the bright entrance on one side

cave_mouth.label: Rocky mountainside with a cave entrance

pass.label: A narrow pass between two high mountains

sea_junction.label: Where two seas meet, a large rock on the shore

poses.walk: walks slowly from its side toward the centre
poses.flee: runs from the centre toward its side and off the stage
poses.gather: a tight group that sways, heads turning

stage.uncountable: optional actor flag 'uncountable': true for group actors: drawn as overlapping silhouettes partly hidden by shadow, rocks or the frame edge, so the number cannot be counted (e.g. the youths of the cave, 18:22)

king.label: Tyrant king / Pharaoh (faceless)
king.note: label «فرعون» (never drawn) gives Pharaoh's Egyptian headdress; otherwise leave the label empty for a crowned king

ruler.label: Righteous ruler (faceless, dignified white and green robes, simple turban; never the tyrant look)

man.label: One faceless man; set 'look': plain | rich (fine robes, gold trim) | poor (simple patched robe) | traveller (staff and bundle)

sleepers.label: Sleepers lying under cloaks, drawn as an uncountable shadowed group (count must be 1)

dog.label: A dog (with pose 'sit' or 'sleep': lying at the entrance, forelegs stretched)

fish.label: A fish in a small basket (see event fish_escape)

rock.label: A large rock to rest by

wall.label: An old wall leaning, about to collapse (see event wall_repair)

barrier.label: The place of the barrier between the two mountains (see event barrier_build); use with setting 'pass', place 'center'

events.storm: dark clouds, strong wind and blowing dust
events.flood: water rises and covers the ground
events.stones: stones rain down from the sky
events.blast: a mighty blast: white flash and shake (the Sayha)
events.sea_part: the sea splits into a dry path between two walls of water (sea_shore setting)
events.light: a soft beam of light from above (guidance, rescue)
events.growth: plants sprout and the land turns green
events.sun_arc: sunlight passes the cave entrance from one side to the other without touching the sleepers (cave setting)
events.turn_sleepers: the sleepers shift from one side to the other
events.wither: the garden is destroyed: vines collapse on their trellises, fruit falls, the land turns barren
events.fish_escape: the fish slips from its basket into the sea, leaving a tunnel-like trail in the water
events.ship_hole: a plank is pulled from the ship, leaving a hole
events.wall_repair: the leaning wall is straightened and restored
events.barrier_build: iron blocks stack up between the mountains, glow red-hot in a fire, then molten copper is poured over them
events.sunset_far: the sun sinks toward a dark water horizon, as it appears to the eye
events.sunrise_open: the sun rises over an open plain with no shelter from it
